- Success criteria: 15-20% reduction in average handle time, <=200ms 90th-percentile latency on search queries, and SLO-driven cost targets.
- Immediate asks from our side: intro to the economic buyer / budget owner and procurement point-of-contact so we can align on pricing and security requirements.

Attached is a short mapping deck that covers architecture options and a recommended pilot configuration. (attachment: acme-mapping-1-presentation.pdf)

1) Intro call with the budget owner (15-20 min) 
2) Share our security packet and procurement checklist with your legal/procurement team
3) Schedule a technical kickoff with Raj/Engineering to scope integration

Are you able to connect us to the right people this week? If it helps, I can propose two times for the intro call.
